description: In every PA-model, folding the empty list returns the initial accumulator.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.foldInto_zero_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program 2)
  (z : M) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.foldInto h).value
      ![Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M, z] =
    z
